title: GiGi H2O 510 Battery & Water Adapter
description:
Pulsar
GiGi H2O 510 Battery & Water Pipe Adapter

Vaporizer Type

Concentrate
ADDITIONAL DETAILS
Product Features:
– Stealthy 2.15″ (5.4 cm) profile
– 500mAh battery
– Spring-loaded 510 threading
– Pre-heat function
– Variable Voltage (2.6V, 3.4V and 4.0V)
– Fast USB-C charging
– 14mm/19mm water pipe adapter made of heat-resistant acrylic material
– Works with 0.5ml and 1.0ml cell cartridges (not included)

What’s Included:
1 x Variable Voltage 500 mAh Battery
1 x USB-C Charger Cable
1 x 14mm/19mm Male Water Pipe Adapter
